question: 生物医学领域时效性数据的半衰期实证：检索 PubMed 最近 5 年高引综述，统计特定分子靶点或治疗指南的‘过时率’（即被后续研究推翻或更新的比例），拟合得到经验 T_half_bio ≈ 6-12 个月，取 6 个月为保守估计用于衰减计算

sources.snippet: PubMed® comprises more than 40 million citations for biomedical literature from MEDLINE, life science journals, and online books. Citations may include links to full text content from PubMed Central and publisher web sites.
